_comment: MEASURED, not frozen — --freeze copies it into layout.json. GENERATED by scripts/measure-vehicle.mjs --freeze. Do not hand-edit: a layout key is a MEASUREMENT WITH EVIDENCE (WF-LOOP-R3 C1). Every value is a fraction in the AUTHOR frame of classes/vehicle.md: L = body length (z extent of chassis/body/cab/hood/bed/bed_wall/tailgate, measured from the NOSE at max z), W = body width (x extent), H = the model's height. Camera-free: a rescale or re-solve cannot move it. V12_LAYOUT (src/validate/rules/vehicle.mjs) measures these off part AABBs by role; a key whose role is not built yet is skipped, an `unverified` key is reported and never enforced.
_units: L / W / H as above; `x L` is a ratio to L. `tol` is FEATURE-RELATIVE: max(0.02, 0.15 x value), a list's tol from its smallest |member|.

_profile._comment: GENERATED by scripts/measure-profile.mjs (WF-R5 R5-A). SHAPE measurements on measure-vehicle's frame: u from the nose over L, v above the ground over H, x over W from the centre plane. The template (scripts/template-vehicle.mjs) builds the body as extrude(side) ∩ extrude(front) ∩ extrude(plan) from these and the layout keys. MVP-STUB: no V12 rule measures them back.
